messages:
maria: Quick sync — launch next Wed. Need final SEO checklist + webinar signup routing. Who can take which bits? :calendar:

tom: I can run a redirects sweep and canonical check. Will confirm old URLs we need to 301.

jess: I will own keyword mapping and the benchmark narrative for the announcement blog + landing page. Planning to draft 3 headline variations and target snippets.

sam: I’ll build the JSON-LD for the webinar page and make sure FAQ/schema snippets are added to the blog. Will post samples.

olivia: I’ll map inbound routing: UTM -> HubSpot -> SDR queue. Need final form fields and GTM event names. @crm-ops can you confirm queue ID?

crm-ops: Confirmed SDR queue = sdriq_07. Also prefer form field `signup_source` + `utm_campaign` to route.

maria: Great. Can we also decide canonical strategy? We have short teaser blog + long launch post + webinar page. We should avoid duplicate snippet dilution.

tom: Proposed: canonical on blog -> long launch post, webinar page uses self-canonical + `event` schema. I'll script a quick check: `curl -I https://redwood.com/launch-short | grep -i link`

seo-bot: Crawl complete on staging — 14 pages flagged: 9 missing canonical, 5 duplicate title tags. Sending list to #docs later.

jess: For benchmark narrative: capture baseline SERP for 5 keywords (latency inference, inference cost optimization, model serving runtime, inference autoscaling, kv-cache caching). We'll record current top snippets and impression opportunities.

sam: Draft JSON-LD snippet for event (put this in head):

```
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar","description":"Live demo of Redwood inference runtime + cost/perf playbook","performer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}</script>
```

olivia: Also want to add hidden UTM capture on the webinar form and GTM trigger `webinar_signup`. Example redirect/UTM rule for legacy links (tom please review):

```
# nginx
rewrite ^/old-launch/(.*)$ /launch/$1 permanent;
```

tom: That redirect looks fine. I'll add a temporary redirect map for all `/old-launch-*` to `/launch/` and run a 302 first for 48 hours, then flip to 301.

maria: Owners + due dates: tom (redirect sweep + canonical fixes) — EOD Mon. jess (keyword brief + headlines) — Tue noon. sam (schema + FAQ snippets) — Tue EOD. olivia (UTM mapping + GTM events) — Tue EOD.

launch-bot: Reminder — add event to calendar and check availability for speakers by 2026-05-04.

jess: Quick SEO checklist items I’ll include in deck: meta descriptions optimized for click, structured data for event, internal linking from product docs (2 links minimum), redirect audit, canonical tags, snippet-targeted H2s.

sam: One more on internal linking — can we add a persistent CTA on product docs sidebar linking to the launch post and webinar? That will help distribute link equity.

maria: Sounds good. Last ask: keep the launch post ~1200–1600 words with an executive TL;DR at top for syndication. jess can draft and we'll iterate with messaging team.

olivia: I'll create a quick spreadsheet mapping UTMs -> landing pages -> HubSpot form IDs and share here.

maria: Perfect — thanks team. If anything blocks owners ping here and we’ll escalate to product. :rocket:
